mentions.name: featureflags.app
mentions.description: A simple feature management system for .NET that provides an easy-to-use UI for configuring feature flags, serving as an alternative to Azure's feature management tooling.
mentions.problem: The built-in .NET feature management libraries work well but lack an easy-to-use UI for configuring flags without having to use Azure.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent a few months building a simple feature management system for .NET - https://featureflags.app.
